subject: Post-discovery: choose a 30-minute overview window for Clearline

Subject: Post-discovery: choose a 30-minute overview window for Clearline

Emily — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Goals: reduce inference latency for patient-facing workflows, lower per-request cost by ~30% across peak windows, and ensure data isolation for PHI.
- Primary evaluation criteria: steady-state 95th percentile latency, predictable throughput for batch inference, and SOC2-compliant audit trails.
- Key stakeholders to include in the next session: your CTO (Tom), security/IT lead, and the engineering owner who will run the pilot.

Next step: propose a focused 30-minute product overview + Q&A to align on success criteria and an initial mutual action plan. I can cover runtime characteristics, routing/fallback options, and a short sketch of a pilot.

Two window options (all in PDT):
1) Wednesday Jul 23 — 11:00–11:30 AM
2) Thursday Jul 24 — 2:00–2:30 PM

If neither works, share two times that do. I've attached a draft mutual action plan and a one-pager for the overview so stakeholders can skim ahead (Clearline-MAP-v1.pdf, product-one-pager.pdf).

Proposed owner: I'll own the session and bring Neha for technical deep-dive questions and Monica for onboarding/ops items.

Links: calendar option 1 — https://calendar.google.com/event?action=VIEW&id=proposal-window-1

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer

Great — Thursday Jul 24 2:00–2:30 PM PDT works for us. I’ve tentatively held the slot and will send a calendar invite after you confirm the attendee list.

Short answers to your asks:
- SSO/KMS: Redwood Private supports SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning for users; for keys we integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM options) and can document an HSM-backed key workflow for audit purposes.
- Quantization/stack: we support FP16, int8 quantized builds, and have tested 4-bit variants for many open models. I’ll attach a one-slide architecture diagram and the product one-pager now.

Pre-read / ask for the session: please have your security lead bring any specific data retention or audit window requirements (e.g., 90-day logs vs. 12 months) so we can confirm compliance behavior in the demo.

I’m attaching the MAP and one-pager again and adding a short architecture snapshot (product-one-pager.pdf). After you confirm attendees I’ll create the calendar invite with dial-in and agenda: 1) 10 min product overview, 2) 10 min pilot/ops discussion, 3) 10 min Q&A and next steps.

Cheers — Karthik

Attachments: Clearline-MAP-v1.pdf; product-one-pager.pdf
